title: Saga Merah
mood: earnest and happily in love, a refrain for a crowd to sing back
subject: a couple spending every Saturday for two years bringing a rusted 1989 Proton Saga back to life under her father's car porch, and the first drive to the beach with the windows wound down
caption: Malay arena pop-rock band anthem in the Insomniacks style. A clean electric guitar on the edge of breakup playing a dotted-eighth delay arpeggio in the intro and verses, opening into wide power chords in the chorus; piano doubling every chord change; a steady eighth-note bass pulse; a live drum kit with a floor-tom build and an open hi-hat and crash lift into each chorus. Polished radio production, roomy and wide, guitars and drums big but the lead vocal clearly on top. Earnest high male tenor, restrained and close in the verses and belted in the final chorus, with a gang of male voices singing the written 'oh-oh' line on the last chorus. 88 BPM, D major. Earnest and happily in love, a refrain made for a crowd to sing back. No fuzz or grunge distortion, no palm-muted punk drive, no orchestral strings, no slow rock kapak wailing guitar solo, no 6/8 power-ballad sway, no autotune, no EDM drop.
lyrics:
[Intro - delay guitar arpeggio and piano]

[Verse 1]
Saga merah, tahun lapan puluh sembilan
Tersadai bawah porch rumah ayah dia, empat-empat tayar kempis
Setiap Sabtu dia hulur spanar, aku baring bawah enjin
Tangan dia hitam minyak, dia kata, "Cantik, kan?"

[Pre-Chorus]
Dua tahun, tiga bateri
Satu karburetor kita cuci dalam sinki

[Chorus]
Pusing kunci, sekali lagi
Enjin batuk, enjin hidup
Dia jerit, satu taman dengar
Dan aku tahu, aku nak dengar jerit dia tu hari-hari

[Verse 2]
Cermin sisi kita cari kat kedai potong
Kusyen belakang dia jahit sendiri, benang lain warna
Ayah dia berdiri tepi pagar, tangan dalam poket
"Kalau rosak tengah jalan, jangan telefon pakcik"

[Pre-Chorus]
Petang tadi kita isi minyak
Sepuluh ringgit, cukup sampai pantai

[Bridge - drums drop to floor toms, guitar swells]
Radio tak jalan, tingkap kena engkol
Dia nyanyi sendiri, sumbang, kuat, aku ikut

[Chorus - full band, gang vocals]
Pusing kunci, sekali lagi
(Oh-oh, oh-oh)
Enjin batuk, enjin hidup
Tingkap turun, angin Port Dickson masuk
Dan aku tahu, aku nak bawa dia jalan macam ni hari-hari

[Outro - delay guitar alone]
Saga merah tu masih batuk, kita masih ketawa
